title: The Sunset Grove of Franklin, TN
description:
Enjoy a warm, welcoming stay at this private country chic retreat where cozy meets stylish in the heart of America's favorite small town. This beautifully decorated space offers the perfect blend of charm & utility, making it the ideal getaway for a relaxing, vibrant visit. Recuperate on the large front porch watching a beautiful sunset chased by hundreds of sparkling fireflies. Experience the perfect blend of comfort, stylish utility & affordability with any creature comfort minutes away.

The space
This is a private space, with. I shared spaces or access points. It has your own private entrance and outside porch to sit and relax on. There are shared doubly “soundproofed” walls for added comfort and privacy.

Guest access
Exclusive use your the Airbnb space, front porch, amenities and yard at your leisure.

Other things to note
There is an Airbnb approved decibel meter in the unit.
